title: Low-Cost and Real-Time Water Contamination Detection in Bangladesh: A Sensor and Machine Learning Approach
venue: 13th International Conference on ICT for Smart Society (ICISS)
overview: Combines IoT sensors with a machine learning detection model to monitor water quality continuously and identify micro-pollutants on the spot, a rapid-prototyping answer to safe water access in developing regions like Bangladesh.

title: The Architect Or The Inhabitant?
overview: A talk on shaping the future of robotics into a dynamic world where humans and machines co-exist together, delivered at an event that asked how technology can amplify humanity instead of replacing it.
